dashboard.name: Cluster Capacity

panels.name: New Panel (4)
panels.markdownSource: ⛳️ **Your nodes can allocate pods whose memory or CPU limits surpass the capacity**. This situation is called *over-commit* and can lead to pod evictions and problems in the nodes.

panels.name: Cluster: Limit Over-commit of CPU Cores
Cluster: % CPU Used vs Limits
panels.description: Only containers with 'Resource Limits' are taken into account.

advancedQueries.query: sum by (kube_cluster_name)(rate(sysdig_container_cpu_cores_used{kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type}[$__interval]) and on (container_id)(avg_over_time(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu",kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type}[$__interval]))) / sum by (kube_cluster_name)(avg_over_time(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu",kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type}[$__interval]))

panels.name: Namespace: % CPU Used vs Requested
panels.description: Only containers with 'Resource Requests' are taken into account.

advancedQueries.query: bottomk(20,sum by (kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace_name)(rate(sysdig_container_cpu_cores_used{kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type}[$__interval]) and on (container_id)(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type} != 0)) / sum by (kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace_name)(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",kube_cluster_name=$cluster,kube_namespace_name=~$namespace, kube_workload_type=~$type}))
